checks.title: Mail goes to Google Workspace
checks.detail: 1 mail server receives mail for getrevlio.com.

checks.title: No SPF record
checks.detail: Receivers can't tell which servers may send as this domain. Gmail requires SPF or DKIM from every sender, and both for bulk senders.

checks.title: DKIM found (google, resend)
checks.detail: Signing keys work; resend uses a 1024-bit key. 2048-bit is the current recommendation.

checks.title: DMARC policy: none
checks.detail: Monitoring only: mail that fails is still delivered, so the domain can still be spoofed. And no rua= address, so nobody receives the reports.

checks.title: No MTA-STS
checks.detail: Optional: forces encrypted delivery to this domain.

checks.title: No BIMI
checks.detail: Optional: shows your logo in some inboxes; needs DMARC at quarantine or reject.

fixes.why: Lets Google Workspace send as getrevlio.com. Add an include: for every other service that sends as you.
Next step, once reports show your real mail passes: failing mail goes to spam.
